details:
This update for shadowsocks-rust, shadowsocks-libev fixes the following issues:

Changes in shadowsocks-rust:

- Fix SELinux denial (name_connect) when forwarding outbound TCP traffic
  (boo#1284975)

- Fix: Unable to bind ports below 1024 with SELinux enabled (boo#1284025)

- Update version to 1.25.0
  * Allow chaining ssserver to another SOCKS5/HTTP/HTTPS proxy
  * Expose user_key() on CryptoStream and ProxyServerStream, lets callers
    identify which multi-user identity was authenticated after an AEAD-2022 handshake
  * EIH (Extended Identity Header) support
  * local-http: Support HTTP Basic auth
  * service: Outbound UDP relay through SOCKS5-only chains. UDP traffic can
    now be relayed through proxy chains when all hops are SOCKS5. Chains containing
    HTTP/HTTPS hops will emit a startup warning and UDP traffic will bypass the chain.
  * socket2::Socket with socket2::SockRef
  * Fix bugs
    * CVE-2026-25541 and boo#1274441
    * CVE-2026-93599, CVE-2026-93602, CVE-2026-93601, CVE-2026-93600 and boo#1282208
    * CVE-2026-25541 and boo#1274441

  * Fix some issues (CVE-2025-3416, boo#1242615)
- Update vendor, fix boo#1215658 and CVE-2023-42811

Changes in shadowsocks-libev:

- Fix SELinux denial (name_connect) when forwarding outbound TCP traffic
  (boo#1284975)

- Fix build for Leap 16.1+: switch BuildRequires from mbedtls-devel to
  mbedtls-3-devel Tumbleweed, don't do this work on Leap 16
